violations.message: Hardcoded secret in configuration, Dockerfile, or CI compose file.
violations.fix: Reference secrets via environment variables (${SECRET_NAME}) or use a secret manager.

violations.message: Untracked workaround or hack comment without an astesia-debt tracking marker.
violations.fix: Use an astesia-debt marker: '// astesia-debt: <reason>, upgrade: <action>' or resolve the workaround immediately.
Read it from the environment (process.env / config module) and document it in .env.example.

violations.message: Unbounded column fetch: SELECT * is banned in production code.
violations.fix: Select only the required columns explicitly.

violations.message: Hallucinated import: relative path or local alias does not exist on disk. ($lib/assets/favicon.svg)
violations.fix: Point the import at a real file or create the module via the proper wave.
